summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Somaliland ayaa soo saartay amar ay ku sheegtay in qof kasta oo ka qaybgala hawlaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya uu wajihi karo tallaabo sharci. Amarka lama caddeyn hawlaha uu khuseeyo iyo sida loo fulin doono.
title: Somaliland oo dadkeeda ka mamnuucday ka qaybgalka siyaasadda Soomaaliya
